rooms.title: First Service
rooms.subtitle: Open U
rooms.description: An open U-shaped kitchen for learning the first salad and dish-washing loop. The compact adjoining café has tables, chairs, table flowers and colourful planters. Rooms and furniture are 15% larger relative to the animals.
rooms.note: The dining area is shorter, with the same seat count and a continuous front aisle. Unity uses soft colour-preserving lighting with real shadows. Customer behaviour is not implemented yet.

rooms.title: Around the Island
rooms.subtitle: Ring route
rooms.description: A central work island separates chopping from cooking. Choose your route around it. The compact adjoining café has tables, chairs, table flowers and colourful planters. Rooms and furniture are 15% larger relative to the animals.
rooms.note: The dining area is shorter, with the same seat count and a continuous front aisle. Unity uses soft colour-preserving lighting with real shadows. Customer behaviour is not implemented yet.

rooms.title: Across the Divide
rooms.subtitle: Two areas · one passage
rooms.description: Preparation and service sit across a low rail. The walking passage stays on the left. The compact adjoining café has tables, chairs, table flowers and colourful planters. Rooms and furniture are 15% larger relative to the animals.
rooms.note: The dining area is shorter, with the same seat count and a continuous front aisle. Unity uses soft colour-preserving lighting with real shadows. Customer behaviour is not implemented yet.

rooms.title: The Zigzag Café
rooms.subtitle: Three areas · offset passages
rooms.description: Three work areas with offset passages. Ingredients can cross two rails while the chef follows the zigzag route. The compact adjoining café has tables, chairs, table flowers and colourful planters. Rooms and furniture are 15% larger relative to the animals.
rooms.note: The dining area is shorter, with the same seat count and a continuous front aisle. Unity uses soft colour-preserving lighting with real shadows. Customer behaviour is not implemented yet.

characters.title: Capybara
characters.subtitle: Male Chef
characters.description: A first textured 3D model from the approved four-look roster. Oversized animal head, short limbs, connected paws and a distinct outfit.
characters.note: Costume is baked into this model. Separate wardrobe pieces and final deformation weights remain future work. Unity includes an approximate preview rig for fitting the character into the café.
